tables.data_basis: measured: calipers and micrometer on fabricated Z-section specimens before web crippling tests
tables.content: Measured cross-sectional dimensions of Z-section web crippling test specimens (EOF loading condition). Refer to Figure 11 in source for dimension definitions.
tables.anomaly_flag: source table lists the fourth Z2 specimen with duplicate label "Z2.3-F" (should logically follow the Z_._4-F pattern used elsewhere); preserved verbatim as printed in the source, not corrected
notes: n_tension flanges: "-F" suffix in specimen_id denotes flanges fastened to support; specimens without suffix are unfastened
column_definitions: specimen_id = test specimen label; -F suffix means flanges fastened to the support
t_in = base metal thickness of the Z-section, inches
B1 (in) = width of the top (loaded) flange, inches (Fig. 11)
B2_in = width of the bottom flange, inches (Fig. 11)
D1_in = overall depth of the web, inches (Fig. 11)
D2_in = top flange stiffening lip length, inches (Fig. 11)
D3_in = bottom flange stiffening lip length, inches (Fig. 11)
N_in = bearing length of the loading plate, inches
L_in = span length between supports, inches
